CustomField.formula: IF(ISBLANK(License_Expiry__c), "Missing", IF(License_Expiry__c < TODAY(), "Expired", IF(License_Expiry__c <= TODAY() + $CustomMetadata.eLogix_Setting__mdt.Document_Expiry_Warning_Days.Number_Value__c, "Expiring Soon", "Valid")))
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Expiring Soon means the licence expires within the eLogix setting Document_Expiry_Warning_Days.
CustomField.label: License Status
